[YeezyGT's S16] [MW: Reload] "The IKELOS_SMG is probably the best PvE Legendary Primary we've ever had post-Recluse, and I doubt we'll ever get anything better. Threat Detector/Surrounded is just certifiably insane; on an SMG as accurate as this, that makes Warmind Cells, that can be paired with some of the strongest Kinetic weapons in the game... It's nigh-on perfect. I actually recommend Alloy Mag here for the first time ever, simply because its noticeable when Threat Detector's no longer active, and you reach the bottom of the mag fast enough to feel that 33% reduced reload speed from Alloy." tags:god-pve
